'''Jean-Loup Puget''' (born 7 March 1947) is a French [[astrophysics|astrophysicist]].  His current research interests lie in the [[Cosmic Microwave Background]]. Jean-Loup Puget and his collaborators reported the first identification of the [[Cosmic infrared background]] using [[Cosmic Background Explorer|COBE]] data.<ref>{{cite journal |author1=J.-L. Puget |author2=A. Abergel |author3=J.-P. Bernard |author4=F. Boulanger |author5=W. B. Burton |author6=F.-X. Désert |author7=D. Hartmann | title = Tentative detection of a cosmic far-infrared background with COBE
| journal = Astronomy and Astrophysics
| volume = 308 |date= 1996 | pages = L5–L8
|bibcode= 1996A&A...308L...5P}}</ref> He is also, along with Alain Léger, credited with the origin of the hypothesis that the series of infrared lines observed in numerous astrophysical objects are caused by emission from [[polycyclic aromatic hydrocarbons]].<ref>{{cite journal |author1=A. Léger |author2=J.-L. Puget | title = Identification of the "unidentified" IR emission features of interstellar dust?
| journal = Astronomy and Astrophysics 
| volume= 137|date=1984|pages=L5–L8
| bibcode=1984A&A...137L...5L
}}</ref>  He is currently principal investigator of the HFI module of the [[Planck (satellite)|Planck]] space mission.

He served two terms as director of the [[Institut d'astrophysique spatiale]] from 1998 to 2005.

He has been a member of the [[Académie des sciences (France)|Académie des sciences]] ([[France]]) since 2002 and was awarded the [[Prix Jean Ricard]] in 1989. He received the [[Committee on Space Research|COSPAR]] Space Science Award in 2014.

Jean-Loup Puget, [[Nazzareno Mandolesi]] and [[ESA]] [[Planck (spacecraft)|Planck]] team were awarded 2018 [[Gruber Prize in Cosmology]] for their definitive measurements of the properties of our expanding universe.<ref>{{cite web|url=https://gruber.yale.edu/prize/2018-gruber-cosmology-prize|title=2018 Gruber Cosmology Prize|access-date=11 May 2018}}</ref>  In 2018 he received the [[Shaw Prize]] in Astronomy.<ref>{{cite press release|date=2018-05-14|title=Announcement of The Shaw Laureates 2018|url=http://www.shawprize.org/en/shaw.php?tmp=5&twoid=79&threeid=278&fourid=554|publisher=[[Shaw Prize|The Shaw Prize Foundation]]|access-date=2018-09-11|archive-date=2018-10-07|archive-url=https://web.archive.org/web/20181007061234/http://www.shawprize.org/en/shaw.php?tmp=5&twoid=79&threeid=278&fourid=554|url-status=dead}}</ref>
